claims: No confirmatory attack-effect inference, hardware validation, acceptance prediction or final study launch.

deadline_rule.cohort: All192 benign streams only;256 measured responses per stream.
deadline_rule.completion: Every offered calibration request including warmup and every background job must finish by fixed horizon; otherwise deadline_status=FAILED.
deadline_rule.empirical_p99: Nearest rank x_(ceil(0.99*n)), one-indexed; n=256, rank=254.
deadline_rule.interpretation: Research threshold, not an operational SLA.

deliverable: Deadline receipt, full candidate table, selected-policy receipt and next-freeze checklist.

fixed_timing.note: No deadline-dependent horizon, early stopping, reseeding or outcome-based expansion.

information_boundary: Own template/seed/public window only; plan precedes private arrivals. Calibration labels concern the calibrator own application, never final victim evaluation.

inherited_model.operations: Ideal gates/EPR; native T1/T2 off; inherited final_si channel13ms exponent1.67.
inherited_model.overhead: Admission, submission and dispatch zero modeled cost; no hardware calibration.

own_selection.denominator: All64 offered measured own requests in every stream; fixed32 streams per regime.
own_selection.eligibility: Independent audits pass; all offered requests including warmup and all jobs finish; exact requested/executed attacker work; empirical on-time fraction>=0.99 in EACH regime.
own_selection.no_feasible: Record selection_success=false; selected offsets=prespecified even fallback.
own_selection.score: Equal-weight mean of the two regimes wrong-and-on-time/offered rates.
own_selection.service_scope: Descriptive training constraint only; no inferential final service certification.

own_training_scheduler: QUOTA_FCFS only; one selected template transfers unchanged later.
pairing: Within each stage/arrival/stream, common arrivals, states, background and simulator seed across templates or schedulers. Different stages use disjoint seed domains.
primary_workload: Six-state teleportation; iid uniform state draws, serial admission.

quota.scope: All attacker PIDs; unbudgeted separate benign/application tenants.

stopping: Any code/source/audit violation halts with raw evidence preserved. Valid incomplete outcomes are retained and calibration reports failure/ineligibility; no automatic retuning.
